name: Generated promos
description: Renders promos from your own templates (text, artwork, music and voice-over) for the shows actually coming up. Install voice plugins for the voice-overs.
author: SchedularrTV

settings.label: Save folder
settings.description: Where rendered promo videos and voice-overs are kept. ErsatzTV must be able to read it. Leave empty for state/generated-promos in the data folder. Changing it doesn't move existing files: copy the old folder across to keep cached voice-overs, so paid voices aren't asked for them again.
